16535.note: 1950s-style diner in a building that opened in 1939 as the Kimo Cafe (Route 66 News).
16535.fn: Building opened 1939 as the Kimo Cafe; Mr. D'z dates from the 1990s.

16907.note: Bar and restaurant on the first floor of the former Durlin Hotel (built 1902, rebuilt 1924 after a 1921 fire, renamed the Oatman Hotel in the late 1960s); museum upstairs.
